findings.label: Offline-safety deviation (resolved)
findings.detail: The design claimed a bare MCPClient in Agent(tools=[...]) constructs offline; against installed strands 1.61.1 it eagerly starts the client. The coder correctly builds gateway-mode with tools=[] + attach_gateway_tools inside 'with mcp_client:', documented the deviation, and the offline gate confirms _is_session_active() is False. No action; not blocking.
